jobs.descriptionText:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects
Recommended Qualifications
6-10 years of experience
Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
Series 7 and 63 preferred
Education
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team.The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients.The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications
15+ years of relevant experience
Experience in people management
Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
Series 79 and 63 licenses

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Job responsibilities

  • Responsible for the overall planning, construction, and operation management of the company's cloud platforms (private cloud, virtualization platform, and public cloud resources), ensuring the stable and highly available operation of business systems;
  • Designed the company's cloud network architecture, dedicated line and VPN connections, VPC and subnet division, DNS, outbound and NAT, cloud routing, as well as isolation of production and testing network environments to meet regulatory requirements;
  • Design cloud platform account and resource hierarchies, identity and access management, tags and naming standards, formulate and implement full lifecycle cloud resource management strategies, covering resource application, approval, delivery, monitoring, capacity planning, and recovery, promoting standardization and automation of resource delivery;
  • Build and maintain an automation foundation, enabling infrastructure as code, configuration management, and autonomous delivery, lead the construction and operation of container cloud platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and promote cloud migration and cloud-native architecture transformation;
  • Capacity planning and management of cloud platforms, version management of each component, and patch updates ensure platform stability and security;
  • Responsible for cloud platform security and compliance, implementing regulatory requirements for Cybersecurity Classified Protection 3.0, data security, and personal information protection, and cooperating with internal and external audits and regulatory inspections;
  • Continuously conduct cloud cost analysis and optimization, establish resource utilization efficiency evaluation mechanisms, and reasonably control IT operating costs;
  • Establish and improve systems, processes, and SOP documents related to cloud platform operation and maintenance, and manage third-party suppliers and cloud service providers related to the platform;
  • Maintain close collaboration with the Group's IT team to implement the Group's global cloud security standards, technical specifications, and management requirements within the company;
  • Track technological development trends in the cloud computing field, assess the application value of new technologies to company business, and provide professional advice for IT architecture evolution.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, software engineering, network engineering, or related fields;
  • Over 8 years of experience in cloud platform planning, construction, or operations and maintenance; candidates with background in fund companies, securities firms, banks, or other financial institutions are preferred;
  • Proficient in mainstream virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, familiar with OpenStack architecture or mainstream private cloud platforms, and familiar with at least one public cloud (Alibaba Cloud, AWS, or Azure) architecture and product architecture;
  • Familiar with container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, with experience in container platform production environment operations and maintenance, proficient in Linux operating system, and proficient in at least one scripting or development language in Python, Shell, or Go;
  • Familiar with basic IaaS principles, including computing virtualization, distributed storage, virtual networks, load balancing, imaging, snapshots, elastic scaling, and other basic cloud components; familiar with and able to build cloud platform monitoring systems;
  • Familiar with TCP/IP networking, storage, and backup disaster recovery technologies; knowledgeable about IaC (Terraform, Ansible); able to develop scripts and automate integration based on cloud platform APIs;
  • Capable of cloud platform capacity assessment, performance tuning, complex fault troubleshooting, as well as solution writing and cross-team project advancement;
  • Familiar with cloud security systems, understanding the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, and regulatory requirements of the securities and fund industry;
  • Fluent in English, able to work as a working language, able to communicate effectively with the Global team;
  • Excellent communication, coordination, documentation, and problem-solving abilities; meticulous and meticulous work experience, strong sense of responsibility, team spirit, and certain team leadership abilities.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Holds cloud computing certifications such as Alibaba Cloud ACP/ACE, AWS, Azure, etc.;
  • Experience in cloud platform maintenance and management for securities and fund companies;

Identifying and assessing red flags and any other potentially concerning information and evaluating the appropriateness of the assigned AML risk rating.
Ensuring the review task is completed before the due date and within SLA requirement
Communicating/escalating issues to management when applicable
Being part of the holistic client review team to follow up on outstanding alignment items within various LOBs and/or GFCC to close loop on the alignment
Being flexible to work on other migration/remediation projects including Screening resolution, other LOB holistic alignment or Quality Assurance

Bachelor's Degree and/or above
Fluent English is mandatory, both written and verbally
Proficient PC skills including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
Relentless and versatile learner with an aptitude for assimilating new industry, company, product or technical knowledge
Highly organized, proactive and motivated with strong prioritization skills, innovation and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated, consistent professional presence with the ability to adapt to evolving needs and situations
Sense of urgency/ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines

Minimum 5 years' experience in the Financial Services industry with a demonstrated track-record of delivery and/or relevant experience in Compliance and KYC

Job Description
Lead with impact as the Country Lead for Document and Business Solutions (DBS) Operations in China, heading a team that keeps the firm's critical document and records services running securely, accurately, and on time. As AI and new technologies transform our organization, you will help move DBS from a paper-based operation to a digital, AI-assisted capability with controls built into every process. Working with our main internal clients, including the Investment Bank, Operations, and Events and Marketing, as well as partners across risk and technology, you will drive operational excellence and deliver scalable solutions that support the firm's growth. This is an opportunity to shape how our operations run day to day, in a culture that values innovation, leadership, and diversity.
Job Responsibilities
Execute the China DBS strategy and roadmap, covering service scope, digitization, modernization, capacity, and location strategy. Align it with regional and global DBS direction, and track the benefits it delivers.
Lead a team of 14 across Shanghai and Beijing covering our services in 8 China sites. Set goals, coach leaders, and build succession plans, training, and cross-coverage for critical processes. Help teams build skills in digital tools, analytics, and automation operations.
Build strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the Investment Bank, Operations, Events and Marketing, CAO functions, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Technology. Understand their priorities, set clear expectations, and turn business needs into prioritized deliverables. Balance competing demands, manage escalations, and influence decisions where you don't have direct authority.
Own the annual budget, headcount, productivity commitments, and cost-to-serve. Deliver savings through demand management, process re-engineering, standardization, and supplier negotiations.
Own end-to-end service performance across sites, including turnaround times, quality, exceptions, rework, and backlog. Support this with capacity and peak planning and resilience coverage.
Ensure our print centres run seamlessly and delivery is within SLA's
Maintain the service catalog, SOPs, quality assurance sampling, and control testing routines, and drive continuous improvement.
Lead incident and escalation management, using structured root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents.
Ensure chain-of-custody integrity and traceability for physical and digital documents through receipt, storage, handover, retrieval, and destruction, with evidence that is ready for audit.
Apply strict change control to workflow, tooling, and routing changes. Partner with Operational Risk, Compliance, Control, and Technology Risk to assess new services, changes, and material incidents.
Modernize paper-based processes through scanning, LLM, metadata tagging, classification, and automated routing. Integrate DBS services with enterprise workflow and records platforms.
Lead the rollout and ongoing operation of intelligent document processing (IDP), robotic process automation (RPA), and GenAI-enabled document handling. Set human review standards, including exception queues, quality sampling, override rules, and monitoring for quality and model drift.
Manage outsourced services and vendors. This covers SLA and KPI scorecards, governance reviews, onboarding and due diligence, performance remediation, concentration risk, and exit readiness.
Serve as the senior DBS contact for country business heads, CAO functions, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Technology. Attend governance forums and report on performance, risks, and roadmap progress with clear metrics.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Strong stakeholder management. Able to explain the vision and strategy clearly and influence people you don't manage. Ability to market our services to other functions.
Proven ability to lead through change and to build a culture of continuous improvement and learning from missteps.
8 years of experience in Operations
Strong knowledge of operational risk and controls, records and information governance, audit readiness, data privacy, and the expectations of a regulated environment.
Proven track record in service transformation, digitization, standardization, and cost and productivity management.
Expertise in process innovation, design, and automation
Proven vendor management and commercial skills, including budgeting, negotiations, and SLA governance.
Data-driven management skills, including KPI design, dashboards, and root-cause analysis.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
Experience rolling out AI or large language model (LLM), IDP, or RPA solutions in regulated workflows, including governance of human review steps.
Experience in a product environment or a global organization focused on banking processes.
Knowledge of China's data protection requirements, such as PIPL, the Data Security Law, and the Cybersecurity Law.
Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin.

Job Summary
The role exists to ensure integrity, availability, control, and continuous improvement of critical Finance and Treasury data platforms and supporting infrastructure within the GFS Data Management portfolio. The role is accountable for maintaining robust information management capabilities that support financial reporting, regulatory obligations, operational decision-making, and business performance across the Bank.
The role develops and executes platform and data management roadmaps, ensuring that data controls, reconciliation processes, validation frameworks, and data quality standards operate effectively and consistently. It serves as the central point of accountability for service stability, infrastructure optimisation, risk management, and operational governance, enabling trusted and timely information for stakeholders.
Working across technology, finance, treasury, risk, and operational teams, the role influences strategic improvements to operating models, controls, and service management practices. Success is achieved through resilient information management capabilities, strong stakeholder partnerships, effective risk mitigation, and sustainable processes that support business continuity and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities
Information Management Strategy & Infrastructure Governance
Develop and maintain information management roadmaps that align data infrastructure capabilities with Finance and Treasury business priorities and regulatory requirements.
Govern the lifecycle of data management platforms, ensuring infrastructure resilience, scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability.
Drive the implementation of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and control frameworks that improve the reliability of critical financial information.
Evaluate emerging business requirements and control changes to enhance information management capabilities and service effectiveness.
Data Quality, Controls & Operational Integrity
Establish and maintain effective control frameworks that detect, prevent, and remediate data quality, reconciliation, and processing issues.
Monitor control effectiveness through metrics, KRIs, KCSAs, testing activities, and governance reviews to strengthen operational integrity.
Analyse control weaknesses, exceptions, and recurring issues to implement sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
Ensure dispensations, control deviations, and risk events are appropriately assessed, documented, escalated, and managed.
Service Management & Operational Resilience
Deliver stable and continuously available information management services through effective service management, monitoring, and operational support models.
Design and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience plans to minimise service disruption and data availability risks.
Optimise infrastructure performance through proactive monitoring, diagnostics, tuning, and capacity planning activities.
Manage configuration controls and operational dependencies to support service reliability and change readiness.
Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership
Build trusted relationships with Finance, Treasury, Technology, Risk, and Operations stakeholders to ensure information management services meet business needs.
Provide insight-driven recommendations using operational and performance data to support informed decision-making and prioritisation.
Communicate service performance, risks, issues, and improvement opportunities through clear governance and reporting mechanisms.
Influence stakeholders to drive standardisation, control enhancements, and consistent adoption of information management practices.
Risk, Compliance & Governance
Embed regulatory, operational, and conduct risk requirements into information management processes and services.
Ensure adherence to applicable policies, governance standards, financial control requirements, and risk management frameworks.
Identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate operational, technology, and information risks impacting business services.
Maintain effective governance processes that provide transparency, accountability, and assurance over information management activities.
Continuous Improvement & Operating Model Effectiveness
Drive process standardisation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and control effectiveness.
Leverage performance metrics and management information to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Improve operating models through business process re-engineering, automation opportunities, and streamlined control execution.
Establish sustainable practices that improve service outcomes while reducing complexity and operational risk.
Skills And Experience
Priority Skills
Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
Configuration Management
Infrastructure Optimization
Risk Management
Regulatory Compliance
Progress Reporting
Stakeholder Engagement
Strategic Planning
Motivations
Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.
Qualifications
Experience operating in complex financial services environments where data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience are critical.
Exposure to enterprise data management platforms supporting Finance, Treasury, Risk, or regulatory reporting functions.
Experience working across technology and business teams to balance service stability, control requirements, and evolving business needs.
Exposure to governance frameworks involving risk management, control assessment, service assurance, and operational oversight.
Experience leading organisational change, process standardisation, and infrastructure optimisation initiatives in large-scale operating environments.
Business English (required)

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
What We Offer
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Internal Audit strengthens the Bank's governance, risk management and control environment by providing independent assurance over the effectiveness of business activities, processes and controls.

Job Summary

Internal Audit strengthens the Bank's governance, risk management and control environment by providing independent assurance over the effectiveness of business activities, processes and controls.

The role enables informed decision-making through objective assessment of risks, controls and regulatory obligations, ensuring potential issues are identified, escalated and addressed appropriately. It supports organisational resilience by delivering assurance, insight and challenge that helps the Bank manage risk effectively while maintaining high standards of governance and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Audit Assurance & Independent Challenge

  • Strengthen confidence in the Bank's governance, risk management and control environment through the delivery of independent, risk-based assurance activities.
  • Improve management understanding of control effectiveness by identifying control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Enhance organisational accountability by providing objective challenge and evidence-based conclusions on key risk and control matters.
  • Support informed decision-making through timely audit observations, recommendations and assurance outcomes.

Risk, Control & Governance Assessment

  • Improve the Bank's ability to manage risk by evaluating the design and effectiveness of governance arrangements, processes and control frameworks.
  • Strengthen the control environment through the identification and assessment of operational, financial, regulatory, conduct and technology-related risks.
  • Enhance visibility of control weaknesses, emerging risks and governance concerns through structured assessment and reporting activities.
  • Support sustainable risk management by evaluating whether remediation actions effectively address identified issues.

Audit Delivery & Quality Excellence

  • Deliver high-quality audit outcomes through the consistent application of Internal Audit methodology, professional standards and quality requirements.
  • Improve audit effectiveness by maintaining robust planning, testing, documentation and evidence-management practices.
  • Enhance confidence in audit conclusions through objective analysis, professional judgement and fact-based assessment.
  • Support continuous improvement of audit practices, tools and methodologies to strengthen audit quality and efficiency.

Skills and Experience

Priority Skills

  • Data Analytics and Insights: Use audit and investigations data to confidently detect anomalies, test hypotheses, identify patterns, and transform evidence into clear forward-looking insights that strengthen scoping, findings, and stakeholder decisions-making.
  • Human and AI Collaboration: Apply AI responsibly to enhance audit & investigation workstreams like research, pattern recognition, documentation and synthesis while maintaining professional judgment, skepticism, confidentiality, and appropriate challenge to validate outputs and decisions
  • Strategic and Proactive Mindset: Anticipate future needs, see beyond tasks and compliance requirements, recognize patterns across engagements, and detect systemic risks early.
  • Relationship Management and Communication: Communicate effectively with auditees, case stakeholders and senior leaders; ask incisive questions; handle difficult conversations well; and convey complex evidence clearly. Proactively build and sustain relationships to stay informed and improve audit planning
  • Resilience and Adaptability: Adapts and remains effective in the face of change and pressure by showing resilience persevering through challenges and recover quickly from setbacks

Other Skills

  • Internal Audit: Internal Audit skill involves evaluating and improving the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes within an organization. Key responsibilities include assessing compliance with financial laws and regulations, and examining internal processes to ensure they are efficient and error-free. A distinctive feature of this skill is its dual focus on assurance and advisory services, which helps organizations not only identify weaknesses but also enhance operational efficiencies.
  • Audit Analytics: Audit Analytics involves the use of data analysis techniques to enhance audit processes, focusing on the evaluation of financial records and transactions for accuracy and compliance. Key responsibilities include identifying risk areas and ensuring regulatory compliance through detailed data assessments. Its distinctive feature is the application of sophisticated analytical tools and techniques to extract actionable insights from large datasets, significantly improving audit efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Compliance Audit: Compliance Audit involves evaluating the adherence of an organization to regulatory guidelines and internal policies. Key responsibilities involve the systematic review of procedures, controls, and operations. Its distinctive characteristic is the emphasis on preventative measures and mitigating risks, ensuring organizations operate within the legal frameworks and industry standards.
  • Audit Finding: Audit Finding involves the identification and documentation of issues uncovered during an audit. Key responsibilities include evaluating compliance with regulations and assessing the adequacy of internal controls. A distinctive feature of this skill is its critical role in enhancing transparency and accountability in organizational processes.
  • Integrity Management: Integrity Management focuses on ensuring ethical practices and moral soundness across an organization's operations. Key responsibilities include establishing ethical guidelines and resolving ethical dilemmas effectively. Its distinctive feature is promoting a trustworthy and transparent work environment, crucial for sustaining long-term organizational success.

Motivations

  • Motivated by understanding how organisations manage risk and identifying opportunities to strengthen governance, controls and decision-making.
  • Energised by analysing complex information, evaluating evidence and providing objective conclusions on important business and risk matters.
  • Enjoy applying professional judgement and independent challenge to improve organisational effectiveness, accountability and resilience.
  • Find satisfaction in working across diverse business areas, building trusted relationships and influencing positive risk and control outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Experience assessing risks, controls, governance arrangements or business processes within audit, risk, compliance, financial services or related environments.
  • Experience performing reviews, testing, analysis or assurance activities to evaluate control effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Experience gathering, interpreting and assessing information from multiple sources to support evidence-based conclusions and recommendations.
  • Experience preparing reports, observations or management insights that communicate risks, issues and findings in a clear and structured manner.
  • Experience engaging with business, risk and control stakeholders to understand operational activities, challenges and control environments

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

To pro-actively promote designated Retail Clients products and services and acquire new customers.

工作范畴：

主动推广指定的个人银行产品和服务及开发新客户。

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in sales promotions and activities to achieve/exceed defined sales targets;
  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 参与促销活动，完成或超额完成指定的销售目标；
  • 跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
  • 以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
  • 主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；
  • 提供高质量、高效的售前和售后服务；
  • 编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Credit appraisal and marketing skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • College/diploma degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

职位要求：

  • 大专及以上学历。
  • 一年以上金融或房贷或房产行业工作经验优先。
  • 有相关银行行业销售经验者优先
  • 了解银行产品、政策及经营策略。
  • 良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。
  • 良好的个人诚信，无任何纪律处分纪录
  • 良好的沟通，表达及学习能力。
  • 优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。

Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employees who have passed the probation, failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

以上的主要工作职责和岗位聘任要求是用于考核试用期是否符合录用条件和工作胜任与否的标准。倘若员工未能满足前述要求，或未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，则该员工将被视为不符合试用期的录用条件，银行有权立即终止员工的劳动合同；对于已过试用期的员工，未能通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的，将作为不胜任工作工作岗位的考核依据。

Before attend and pass the “CPBB Essentials” class, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。
